item.title: NIPSCO offers temporary relief for high winter energy bills
item.description: NIPSCO is offering temporary financial support to customers struggling with high energy bills due to recent winter weather, including waiving late and reconnect fees, pausing service disconnections for nonpayment, and reducing gas reconnect deposits.

item.title: Chicago 'front runner' to host Democratic National Convention in 2028 and 2032
item.description: Chicago is a front-runner city to host the Democratic National Convention in 2028 and 2032, following the successful 2024 convention.

item.title: Clouds may limit the viewing of Tuesday morning’s Lunar Eclipse
item.description: Much of the day on Tuesday will spent under an extensive cloud deck, and the chance of some patchy light rain and sprinkles at times, especially in the morning.

item.title: Pushback and praise from Illinois leaders after U.S. strikes on Iran
item.description: U.S. and Israeli airstrikes on Iran have left many wondering how long the conflict could last and what comes next. Illinois' elected leaders and candidates for office are weighing in, some in support of the military campaign and some against.

item.title: Glenview Police investigate injury case near busy suburban corporate hub
item.description: A person was taken to Lutheran General Hospital for treatment after being found injured in a corporate area of the north suburbs, and the Glenview Police Department and NORTAF are investigating the incident.

item.title: Community groups say they've been shut out of development talks around new Chicago Fire FC stadium
item.description: Community organizers in Chicago have expressed concerns that they have been excluded from the planning process for the $7 billion megadevelopment project, The 78, which includes a privately funded $750 million soccer stadium, and are calling for legally-binding safeguards to protect residents.
